issues.description: The problem specification and template refer to a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) on SealSaloon, but the solution implementation defines a static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int). This identifier mismatch (acceptSupplyDelivery vs receiveDelivery) will confuse students about which method to implement and will cause inconsistencies when following the provided Main example or tests that expect the name from the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Use the same method name across artifacts. Either rename the solution method receiveDelivery to acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), or update the problem statement and template Main to refer to receiveDelivery. Ensure the static signature and behavior remain unchanged so students and examples/tests reference the same identifier.
